title: YesStyle first order: stack a store coupon with 5% off from Reward Code CECILIA010
seoTitle: YesStyle first order: store coupon + 5% with CECILIA010
description: Find the YesStyle coupon, combine it with CECILIA010 and learn which field takes each code: 5% extra on a first order, 2% on later ones, on the website and in the app.
metaDescription: CECILIA010 gives 5% extra on a first YesStyle order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field. See where to find the store coupon to add on order one.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: On a first YesStyle order, CECILIA010 gives 5% extra in the Reward Code field (2% on later orders) and can be used together with a store coupon, in the Coupon Code field. The campaign coupon is on our [YesStyle coupons](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page; personal coupons, if any, appear in your account, under Account > Coupons. Before you fill your cart, check that YesStyle delivers to your country.

contentSections.heading: YesStyle first order: the store and what to use
paragraphs: YesStyle is a Hong Kong store, online since 2006, that sells Korean beauty, Asian cosmetics and fashion to more than 150 countries. If this is your first order and you are not sure you can trust it, the company details and return rules are in [is YesStyle legit and safe?](/en/reviews/is-yesstyle-legit-and-safe-review).

On a first order, the discount can come from two places: a coupon from YesStyle itself, when there is one valid for your order, and our Reward Code, CECILIA010. With the code, the store lists 5% extra on the first order and 2% on later ones.
A code copied from other sites may be expired: check the discount line in the order summary before paying.

contentSections.heading: Coupon + Reward Code: two discounts in one order
paragraphs: YesStyle checkout has two code fields, and each one takes one kind of code:
bullets: **YesStyle coupon:** goes in the Coupon Code field. It changes with each campaign, has an end date and often asks for a minimum order. The store accepts one per order.
**CECILIA010:** goes in the Reward Code field. It is fixed and does not change between campaigns: 5% extra on the first order and 2% on later ones.
postParagraphs: Because the fields are separate, the Reward Code does not take the place of the coupon. If there is a coupon eligible for your order, both go in together: check both discount lines in the order summary before paying.
You can find both on our [YesStyle coupons](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page: the coupon that is valid now, updated with each campaign, and CECILIA010.

contentSections.heading: Where to find the YesStyle coupon
paragraphs: The campaign coupon usually lasts only a few days, so check its end date when you buy. Look in these four places:
bullets: **Our coupons page:** the [YesStyle coupons](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page shows the campaign coupon in effect, checked on the official site, with its end date.
**Your YesStyle account:** in the app with the English interface, tap Account and then Coupons. Personal coupons tied to your account appear there, and the list can be empty.
**Your email:** YesStyle sends coupons by email, and existing customers can get exclusive coupons. Check your inbox and your promotions tab before you place the order.
**The store home page:** the website and the app usually show the campaign coupon in a banner, with the code ready to copy.

image.caption: Campaign coupon on the home screen and personal coupons under Account > Coupons, in the English Android app. In this capture the account had no personal coupons, and the campaign code was covered.

postParagraphs: The campaign coupon and your account coupons can be different, and only one goes in per order. If more than one works for your cart, compare the conditions and keep the one that gives the biggest discount in the summary. If checkout rejects the coupon, the most common reasons are in [how to find and combine YesStyle coupons](/en/reviews/how-to-find-valid-yesstyle-coupon-codes).

contentSections.heading: What about the second order?
paragraphs: On the second order, CECILIA010 still works, with 2% extra. The code and the field are the same: only the percentage changes.
Store coupons stay separate. It is worth checking the Coupons section of your account and your email again: existing customers may get exclusive coupons, but they do not arrive with every order.

contentSections.heading: Before your first order: delivery
paragraphs: Before you fill your cart, check your destination: confirm that YesStyle delivers to your country, because the code does not change where the store ships.
Delivery times, shipping costs and taxes for the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland and New Zealand are in the [YesStyle shipping guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: Where to enter each code
paragraphs: Sign in to your YesStyle account before applying the codes. The field name changes depending on the screen; these are the two paths:
bullets: **On the website:** at checkout, the store coupon, if there is one, goes in Coupon Code. CECILIA010 goes in a different field, Reward Code. Type it and apply it.
**In the app:** tap Enter Code. The store coupon, if there is one, goes in Coupon Code, and CECILIA010 goes right below it, in the Influencer / Rewards Code field. Tap Apply.

image.alt: Three screens of the YesStyle app: the bag with the Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code line, the Enter Code screen with the Coupon Code and Influencer / Rewards Code fields, and the summary with CECILIA010 applied
image.caption: The three steps in the Android app, on an account in English with delivery to the United States, without placing an order.

postParagraphs: In our app test, the code was accepted and the summary showed an Influencer Code Discount (5% OFF) line. The step-by-step with website screens is in [how to use CECILIA010](/en/reviews/yesstyle-reward-code-coupon-cecilia010).
contentSections.emphasis: On a first order, the Reward Code is the small, steady discount and the campaign coupon is the big, passing one. Use both, but don't expect CECILIA010 alone to change the total much.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: What is the YesStyle Reward Code for a first order? CECILIA010: 5% extra on the first order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field.

Where do I find the YesStyle coupon that is valid now? The campaign coupon is on our [YesStyle coupons](/en/coupons/yesstyle) page and in the store banners. The Coupons section of your account and YesStyle emails may bring personal coupons.
Can I use a YesStyle coupon and CECILIA010 on the same order? Yes, with an eligible coupon: the coupon goes in the Coupon Code field and CECILIA010 goes in the Reward Code field.
Do existing customers get YesStyle coupons? They can, with no guarantee: the store sends exclusive coupons by email, and the Coupons section of your account shows the ones available.
Does CECILIA010 work on a second order? Yes, with 2% extra on later orders.
Which field does CECILIA010 go in? The Reward Code field, separate from the coupon field: it is a Reward Code.
Does CECILIA010 work in the app? Yes: type the code in the Influencer / Rewards Code field on the Enter Code screen.

takeIf: You're placing your first YesStyle order and want to stack the CECILIA010 Reward Code on a store coupon when a valid one exists.
You've bought there before and want to know what changes from order two: the code still works, at 2%.
skipIf: You need delivery to a country the store doesn't ship to: check the destination before building a cart, because no code changes that.
You expect a big discount from the code alone: it gives 5% on the first order and 2% after, and anything bigger depends on a store coupon.
